causal_chain: FDIR raises ADCS_ERROR and commands safe mode at T-0s
Rate output becomes invalid without an SEU trigger
Gyro telemetry dropout without gyro hardware fault

recovery_plan.rationale: Power-cycle the gyro driver to clear the SEU latch-up.
recovery_plan.verify: Gyro_rate_degs returns a finite value within limits

recovery_plan.rationale: Invented command — exercises the registry check.
Re-establish the attitude reference once rates are valid.

reasoning_summary: The SEU counter incremented before the gyro rate became invalid, and attitude error grew only afterwards. That ordering favours a single-event upset in the gyro driver over a mechanical failure, which would not be preceded by an SEU count.
